name: SLA Timer
tagline: A live countdown to a deadline column, with warning and overdue states.

presets.name: On track
presets.description: A deadline comfortably outside the warning threshold.

presets.name: Due soon
presets.description: The warning state. A demo preset is static JSON and cannot hold a date twenty minutes from now, so this reaches the warning band the honest way — a very wide threshold rather than a faked clock.

presets.name: Overdue
presets.description: A deadline that has passed. The state is a word as well as a colour, which is what makes it readable in high contrast.

presets.name: Elapsed, as digits
presets.description: The same overdue deadline with display set to elapsed — a running duration rather than a phrase, with the seconds moving.

presets.name: No deadline
presets.description: An empty column. It says so rather than showing a timer at zero, and stops the clock.
